blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Ill-posed inverse problems require priors to constrain the solution space toward plausible outcomes.
In inverse rendering, learned priors modeling the distribution of natural illumination improve the recovery of scene properties.
However, existing models rely on the distant-illumination assumption, representing lighting as a far-field environment map.
This limits their applicability to indoor scenes, where illumination is highly spatially varying due to finite-distance emitters, visibility changes, and parallax, all of which are poorly approximated by a single environment map.
To address this, we introduce a spatially-aware illumination prior trained on real-world indoor panoramas and their estimated depth.
Our variational autoencoder model learns a compact, optimizable latent space that decodes into HDR radiance and depth, parameterizing an area light emitter for direct integration into standard differentiable rendering pipelines.
This design bridges the plausibility guarantees of a learned prior with the gradient flow required for downstream optimization.
Crucially, by jointly modeling radiance and depth, our prior captures the spatial structure of indoor illumination, instead of treating the light sources as infinitely distant.
We demonstrate that this formulation enables spatially-varying illumination modeling and achieves higher-fidelity recovery of indoor lighting compared to existing approaches.
Project page: https://andreead-a.github.io/RoomLight
blocks.zh:
出现反面问题需要先验才能限制解决办法的空间,使其取得可能的结果。
在反向渲染中,学习到的先兆模拟自然照明的分布,改善了场景特性的恢复.
然而,现有的模型依赖于远射假设,代表照明作为远野环境图.
这限制了它们对室内场景的适用性,因为室内场景的照明因有限距离的发射器,能见度变化,以及抛射物而有很大的空间差异,而所有这些场景都与单一的环境图相差甚远.
为了解决这个问题,我们引入了空间意识照明,事先受过关于现实世界室内全景及其估计深度的培训。
我们的变异自编码器模型学习了一个紧凑、可选择的潜在空间,将代码解码为HDR的光度和深度,将一个区域光发射器参数化,以便直接融入标准的不同渲染管道。
这种设计桥梁是下游优化所需的梯度流之前所学的可信保证。
关键是,通过联合建模光度和深度,我们之前就抓住了室内照明的空间结构,而不是将光源视为无限遥远.
我们证明,这种配方能够进行空间变异的照明模型制作,比起现有方法,室内照明的恢复性更高。

In contrast, a 2.5D area lighting representation, obtained by texturing a depth-based mesh with the HDR panorama, models spatially-varying illumination and closely reproduces the original rendering. blocks.en:
Recovering the illumination of a scene from input images with limited field of view (FOV) is a cornerstone of inverse rendering [ 10 , 2 , 17 ] , with applications including material estimation [ 63 , 59 ] , scene relighting [ 20 , 37 , 8 ] and photorealistic object insertion [ 19 , 42 ] .
Yet, the problem is severely ill-posed as geometry, reflectance and lighting are tightly coupled in image formation.
Illumination estimation is particularly challenging because, at any surface point, incoming light arrives from almost every direction, often originating outside the camera’s field of view, and spans a high dynamic range (HDR) of intensities.
blocks.zh:
从视野有限的输入图像(FOV)中恢复对一个场景的照明,是反向渲染[10,2,17]的基石,应用包括材料估计[63,59],场景重燃[20,37,8]和光现实主义物体插入[19,42].
然而,由于几何、反射和照明在图像形成方面紧密结合,这一问题被严重忽视。
光照估计尤其具有挑战性,因为在任何表面点,光照从几乎每个方向运来,往往来自镜头视野之外,并且跨越高度动态(HDR)范围。

blocks.en:
The dominant paradigm for representing scene illumination is the spherical environment map [ 10 ] , which encodes incident radiance as a function of direction at a single point.
Environment maps capture high-frequency lighting detail and therefore reproduce intense specular highlights and complex reflections on glossy surfaces faithfully, but they are spatially invariant by construction due to the distant-light assumption.
While outdoor daylight scenes satisfy this assumption reasonably well, real interiors do not.
Nearby emitters produce strong parallax, and illumination varies significantly with position due to inverse-square falloff and changes in visibility, so a single environment map cannot match the underlying light field.
blocks.zh:
代表场景照明的主导范式是球形环境图[10],该图将事件光度编码为单点方向的函数.
环境图捕捉高频照明细节,因此在光泽表面忠实地复制强烈的光谱亮度和复杂的反射,但由于远光假设,它们因构造而具有空间变化性.
虽然室外的日光场景可以合理地满足这一假设,但真实的室内却不能.
靠近的发射器产生强的抛射物,由于反方落地和能见度变化,照明位置差异很大,因此单一的环境图无法与基础光场匹配.

blocks.en:
Intuitively, accounting for the finite distance between the illumination representation and the scene geometry removes this limitation.
Computer graphics and game engines have long exploited this through parallax-corrected cubemaps [ 30 ] , which map the environment onto proxy geometry such as spheres [ 5 ] or boxes [ 53 ] , but such proxies cannot represent real interior layouts.
We instead adopt a depth-based formulation: the HDR panorama is projected onto a mesh reconstructed from its own depth map, yielding what we call a 2.5D area light , also recently described as an emissive mesh [ 41 ] .
A single additional channel changes the representation class.
An environment map is a function of direction alone. Adding depth makes the emitter a surface in space, so the illumination it produces varies with position and direction.
This allows illumination to vary naturally across the scene, so the same object appears differently depending on where it is placed.
Fig. 1 shows that even in a simple indoor scene, no single environment map can reproduce the appearance of two nearby objects simultaneously, regardless of capture position, whereas a 2.5D area light can.
blocks.zh:
直观地,计及光线表示与场景几何之间的有限距离,消除了这一限制.
计算机图形和游戏引擎早就通过parallax校正立方体[30]来利用这一点,这些立方体将环境映射到代理几何上,如球体[5]或盒体[53],但这种代理体不能代表真实的内部布局.
相反,我们采用了一种基于深度的提法:将《人类发展报告》的全景投射到从自己的深度图上重建的网格上,产生我们所称的2.5D区光,最近也被描述为传送网[41]。
一个额外的频道会改变代表等级.
环境图仅是方向的函数. 添加深度使发射器在空间中形成一个表面,因此其产生的照明因位置和方向而异.
这使得照明在整个场景中自然而然的变异,因此同一个物体根据放置地点而出现不同.
图1显示,即使在简单的室内场景中,任何单一的环境图都无法同时复制两个附近物体的外观,无论捕获位置如何,而2.5D区光线可以.

blocks.en:
2.5D area lights are directly compatible with existing differentiable rendering frameworks [ 24 ] , but recovering one from a single image is even more underconstrained than recovering an environment map: the representation spans both radiance and geometry, and most of it is never observed.
Direct optimization is consequently prone to overfitting, often converging to noisy and implausible solutions.
Still, real-world illumination is far from
arbitrary, as indoor and outdoor environments alike exhibit strong statistical regularities [ 12 ] .
Data-driven priors [ 16 , 15 , 54 , 40 , 7 ] exploit this property by replacing an unconstrained pixel grid with a compact latent space whose decoded samples remain plausible throughout optimization.
Existing priors, however, are direction-only by construction: their latent codes decode radiance as a function of direction alone, with no notion of how far the emitting surfaces are.
blocks.zh:
2.5D区灯直接与现有的不同渲染框架[24]兼容,但从单一图像中恢复一个比恢复环境图更缺乏约束性:表示既跨越光度,也跨越几何,大部分从未被观察到.
因此,直接优化容易过度适应,往往与吵闹和不可信的解决办法趋同。
然而,现实世界的照明远非
由于室内和室外环境都表现出强烈的统计规律[12]。
数据驱动的前身[16, 15, 54, 40, 7] 利用这一属性,将不受约束的像素网格替换为紧凑的潜在空间,其解码样本在整个优化过程中仍然可信。
然而,现有的前科只是通过构造来进行方向化:其潜在的编码解码光度仅作为方向的函数,而不知道排放表面有多远。

blocks.en:
This leaves a gap: the representation that indoor scenes require has no prior, and existing priors cannot represent it.
We close this gap with a spatially-aware illumination prior tailored to indoor environments.
We train a convolutional variational autoencoder on equirectangular panoramas pairing HDR radiance with aligned depth, so a single latent code decodes both the emissive texture and the geometry of a 2.5D area light.
Decoding is differentiable end to end, letting photometric gradients from a differentiable renderer propagate back to the latent code.
The prior thus serves directly as the illumination parameterization in an analysis-by-synthesis setting for inverse rendering, where scene parameters are recovered by rendering a hypothesis and comparing it against the observation.
We show that optimizing in this latent space recovers spatially varying indoor illumination more accurately than environment-map priors fitted through the same renderer, and that it transfers to real photographs.
blocks.zh:
这留下了一个空白:室内场景所需的代表没有前科,现有的前科不能代表它.
我们通过空间意识的照明来弥合这一差距,先适应室内环境。
我们在平方方圆光谱上训练一个旋转变异自编码器,将HDR的光线配对成对的深度,所以一个单一的潜伏编码可以解码一个2.5D区域光线的发射纹理和几何.
解码是不同的结尾,可以使光度梯度与不同的渲染器传播回潜在的编码。
因此,前一种直接作为反向渲染的逐项分析的光线参数化,通过提出假说并将其与观测进行比较,从而恢复场景参数。
我们显示,优化这一潜在空间比通过同一渲染器安装的环境图前身更准确地恢复空间上不同的室内照明,并将它转移到真实的照片上。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Method overview. We pre-train a convolutional VAE on paired HDR radiance and depth panoramas to encode an environment into a global latent vector z z . For illumination recovery the encoder is discarded and the decoder is frozen. The decoded pair is lifted into a 2.5D area light which illuminates the objects in a differentiable renderer. The photometric loss between the rendered image and the target observation is backpropagated through all steps to the latent code z z and the exposure scale s s .
blocks.zh: 图2:方法概述。 将环境编码成全球潜在矢量z z。 对于照明恢复,编码器被丢弃,解码器被冻结. 解码对被提升成2.5D区光线,在不同的渲染器中照亮物体。 制成的图像与目标观测之间的光度损失通过所有步骤向潜在编码z z和曝光尺度s 进行反向传播。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Recovering intrinsic scene properties such as geometry, material reflectance and incident illumination from images is a long-standing problem in computer vision and graphics [ 3 ] .
Classical shape-from-shading formulations avoid the illumination unknown altogether, assuming a single distant source of known direction [ 23 ] .
Virtually all methods that do estimate lighting retain the distant-illumination assumption and differ mainly in how they parameterize the resulting environment map [ 10 ] .
Low-order spherical harmonics (SH) [ 44 , 4 ] and mixtures of spherical Gaussians (SG) [ 51 , 64 ] provide a compact, smooth basis that is cheap to optimize and adequate for diffuse reflectance, but their limited angular bandwidth cannot express the high-frequency illumination needed for sharp specular reflections.
Recent inverse-rendering pipelines therefore optimize the environment map non-parametrically, as an unconstrained pixel grid [ 20 , 56 ] , trading compactness for expressiveness.
This optimization is driven by differentiable renderers [ 24 , 31 , 33 ] through photometric reconstruction losses, where a high-dimensional, unregularized lighting representation makes the problem severely under-constrained.
We target this trade-off with an indoor illumination prior that is expressive yet low-dimensional, and whose latent parameters are directly optimizable within such frameworks.
blocks.zh:
从图像中恢复几何,材料反射和事件照明等内在场景属性是计算机视觉和图形中长期存在的问题[3].
古典形状的阴影配方完全避免了不明的照明,假定已知方向的单一远源[23].
几乎所有估算照明的方法都保留了远照假设,主要在如何参数化所形成的环境图[10]方面有所不同.
低序球形口琴(SH)[44,4]和球形高斯琴(SG)[51,64]的混合物提供了一个紧凑,光滑的基础,可以便宜地优化,足以进行扩散反射,但是其有限的角带宽不能表达锐光谱反射所需的高频光度.
因此,最近的逆向输油管优化了环境图的非参数化,作为一个不受约束的像素网格[20,56],交易紧凑性以表达性.
这种优化是由不同的渲染器[24,31,33]通过光度重建损失推动的,其中高维的,不规范的照明表现使得问题严重不足.
我们的目标是通过室内照明实现这种取舍,而室内照明既具有明示性,又低维度,其潜在参数可在这种框架内直接选择。

blocks.en:
Inverse rendering is inherently ill-posed, as multiple combinations of material and illumination can explain the same observed image.
Linear statistical models over parametric lighting representations capture distributions of low-dimensional illumination coefficients [ 62 , 13 , 2 ] , but are limited by the expressiveness of the underlying parametric model.
Learned environment map models are more expressive, ranging from convolutional autoencoders [ 7 , 49 ] to variational auto-decoders with neural field decoders [ 15 , 16 ] and large-scale variational autoencoders [ 54 ] .
Diffusion Posterior Illumination [ 40 ] instead integrates a denoising diffusion model [ 22 ] into optimization-based inverse rendering, improving realism and mitigating the material–illumination ambiguity.
Yet all these priors produce a single global estimate, ignoring the spatially varying nature of real indoor lighting.
We instead model the geometry of the illumination environment explicitly, enabling more accurate indoor inverse rendering.
blocks.zh:
反向渲染本质上是不正确的,因为材料和照明的多重组合可以解释同一被观察到的图像.
线性统计模型相对于参数光度表示法,捕捉低维光度系数的分布[62,13,2],但受到基础参数模型的表达力的限制.
所学环境图模型更具有表达性,从演化自动编码器[7,49]到带有神经场解码器的变异自动解码器[15,16]和大规模变异自动编码器[54].
扩散前光学[40]转而将消音扩散模型[22]整合到基于优化的反向渲染中,改进现实主义并减轻材料-光学的模糊性.
然而所有这些前科都产生了一个单一的全球估计,忽略了真实室内照明的空间性质差异.
相反,我们明确地模拟了照明环境的几何形状,使室内反向渲染更加准确。

blocks.en:
Early learning-based approaches to indoor illumination estimation predict a single global environment map for an entire scene [ 17 , 55 , 26 ] , which fails to capture spatially varying lighting effects.
To address this limitation, per-pixel lighting predictions using spatially-varying SH [ 19 ] , SG [ 35 , 66 ] , or locale-dependent HDR panoramas [ 47 ] were introduced.
However, these methods remain restricted to 2D image-space representations and do not enforce a coherent 3D lighting structure. [ 18 ] directly predicts localized 3D light sources, but cannot capture the level of detail required for accurate reflections. [ 58 ] introduced a volumetric SH representation defined on a voxel grid, enabling lighting queries at arbitrary 3D positions and view directions.
This approach was later extended to video input in [ 36 ] .
More recently, generative methods have demonstrated that spatially-varying illumination can be recovered by inpainting light probes in input images [ 42 ] or video frames [ 50 , 6 ] .
Alternatively, the limited FOV input images can be outpainted into full panoramas, which are then converted into emissive meshes using estimated panorama depth [ 41 ] .
While these methods achieve strong performance in their respective settings, they are primarily designed to directly predict illumination for specific applications such as object insertion.
As a result, they do not provide a learned prior that can be incorporated into optimization-based inverse rendering frameworks.
This limitation can lead to unrealistic illumination estimates and prevents the joint recovery of other scene properties such as material parameters.
Instead, our approach introduces a neural prior for spatially-varying illumination that can be integrated into inverse rendering pipelines, enabling more consistent estimation of lighting and other scene attributes.
blocks.zh:
早期基于学习的室内照明估计方法预测整个场景的单一全球环境地图[17,55,26],无法捕捉空间差异的照明效果.
为解决这一局限性,采用了空间变化的SH[19]、SG[35、66]或依赖地方的HDR全景预测。
然而,这些方法仍然限于2D图像空间的表示,没有强制实施一个连贯的3D照明结构. [18]直接预测局部的3D光源,但无法捕捉准确反射所需的详细程度. [58] 引入了在voxel网格上定义的音量SH表示,允许在任意的3D位置和视图方向进行照明查询.
这种方法后来被推广到[36]的视频输入.
最近,基因方法表明,通过在输入图像[42]或视频帧[50,6]中插入光线探测器,可以恢复空间变化的照明。
或者,有限的FOV输入图像可以被涂成完整的全景图,然后利用估计全景深度将全景图转换成发射网目. [41].
虽然这些方法在各自的环境下取得了强效,但主要是为了直接预测对象插入等特定应用的照明.
因此,它们不会提供可以纳入基于优化的反向渲染框架的事先经验。
这种限制会导致不切实际的照明估计,并阻止其他场景属性如材料参数的联合恢复.
相反,我们的方法引入了空间变化照明之前的神经元,可以结合到反向渲染管道中,从而能够更一致地估计照明和其他场景属性。

blocks.zh: 3 方法

Viewing angles: 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} elevation (emitter mesh), 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} (scene layout).

blocks.en:
We propose an illumination prior for indoor scenes: a variational autoencoder over HDR equirectangular panoramas augmented with an aligned radial depth channel.
A single global latent code z z summarizes an entire environment.
Decoding it yields a radiance map and a depth map, which we lift into a 2.5D area light usable directly as an emitter in a differentiable rendering framework.
Illumination can then be recovered from images by optimizing z z through the renderer, so the prior restricts the solution to plausible indoor environments while the depth channel makes the recovered illumination spatially varying.
Fig. 2 provides an overview.
blocks.zh:
我们建议在室内场景之前先进行照明:在HDR等角光谱上安装一个变异的自动编码器,并增加一个对齐的射线深度通道。
一个单一的全球性潜伏代码z z总结了整个环境.
解码它产生一个辐射图和深度图, 我们把它提升到一个2.5D区域光线, 可以在不同的渲染框架中作为发射器直接使用。
然后可以通过渲染器优化z z来从图像中恢复光线,所以之前将溶液限制在可信的室内环境,而深度通道则使回收光线在空间上有所不同.
图2提供了概况。

blocks.zh: 3.1 室内建筑

We construct from the pair ( L , D ) (L,D) a 2.5D area light, represented as a closed triangle mesh with an emissive texture, by exploiting the spherical parametrization of the equirectangular image domain.

blocks.en: 3.2 Panoramic convolutional VAE

blocks.en:
We model the joint distribution of radiance and depth with a convolutional VAE [ 28 ] that compresses a panorama into a single global latent z ∈ ℝ 512 z\in\mathbb{R}^{512} .
A global code enforces holistic consistency across the environment and gives downstream optimization a compact, low-dimensional search space.
blocks.zh:
将全景压缩成单一全球潜伏的z → R 512 z\in\mathb{R}^{512}。
全球代码在整个环境中执行整体一致性,并给予下游一个紧凑的低维搜索空间.

blocks.en:
The encoder is a convolutional stem followed by four stages of strided residual downsampling [ 21 ] with GroupNorm [ 60 ] and SiLU [ 14 ] .
The resulting feature map is projected to the parameters of a diagonal Gaussian posterior q ϕ ​ ( z ∣ x ) = 𝒩 ⁡ ( μ ⁡ ( x ) , diag ⁡ σ 2 ​ ( x ) ) q_{\phi}(z\mid x)=\mathcal{N}\!\left(\mu(x),\operatorname{diag}\sigma^{2}(x)\right) , from which z z is drawn using the reparametrization trick.

The decoder symmetrically upsamples and refines features via residual blocks to reconstruct the panorama.
To propagate global context across all scales, we modulate decoder feature maps via Adaptive Group Normalization [ 27 , 11 ] , which also improves gradient flow during downstream latent optimization.
blocks.zh:

为了在所有尺度上宣传全球背景,我们通过适应性组态化来调制解码器特征图[27,11],这也改善了下游潜在优化过程中的梯度流.

blocks.en:
Two design choices adapt the architecture to the spherical topology of the equirectangular domain.
First, we follow [ 25 ] in using standard convolution kernels and replacing zero padding with circular padding [ 67 ] : wrap-around in longitude, and across each pole by reflecting the boundary rows and rolling them by W / 2 W/2 , which is where the neighbourhood beyond the pole actually lies on the sphere. Second, convolutions are translation-equivariant, whereas equirectangular statistics are strongly latitude-dependent.
We therefore make latitude explicit by concatenating the cosine and sine of the polar angle, ( cos ⁡ θ , sin ⁡ θ ) (\cos\theta,\sin\theta) , as two additional channels to the inputs of both the encoder and the decoder [ 38 ] .
blocks.zh:
两个设计选择使建筑适应等角域的球形地形.
首先,我们遵循 [25] 使用标准内核,用圆形内核代替零贴板 [67] :在经纬度内进行环绕,并且通过反射边界线条并用 W / 2 W/2 滚动来横跨每个柱子,这是柱子外的邻域实际位于球体的地方. 第二,演变是翻译-等同的,而等同统计则高度依赖纬度。
因此,我们通过调和极角的余弦和正弦来明确纬度(cos θ, sin θ) (\cos\theta,\sin\theta),作为编码器和解码器输入的两个额外渠道[38].

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
This section presents the training, evaluation protocol, and empirical performance of our proposed prior across various settings. First, Sec. 4.1 assesses the prior in isolation as a joint generative model of radiance and depth. Next, Sec. 4.2 evaluates its integration into the inverse-rendering optimization loop (Sec. 3.4 ) on synthetic scenes.
Finally, Sec. 4.3 tests performance on real-world photographs with a more challenging setup.
Further results, including an ablation study, are presented in the supplementary material, Sec. C .
blocks.zh:
本节介绍我们拟议在各种情况下的培训、评价协议和经验业绩。 第一,第4.1条将先前作为辐射和深度的联合基因模型孤立地评估。 接下来,4.2sec评价其融入合成场景上的反向递归优化循环(Sec.3.4).
最后,4.3 Sec以更具挑战性的设定测试现实世界照片的性能.
补充材料C.Sec.介绍了进一步的结果,包括一项研究。

blocks.en:
Our illumination prior requires indoor HDR panoramas paired with depth maps, but no real-world dataset provides such pairs at sufficient scale.
We therefore augment the Laval Indoor HDR dataset [ 17 ] with pseudo-ground-truth depth from an off-the-shelf monocular estimator [ 57 ] , and inpaint the nadir blind spot of the capture setup [ 48 ] (see Fig. 4 ).
This yields 2233 2233 training samples.

因此,我们用一个现成的单视估计器的伪地面-真实深度来扩充Laval室内人类发展报告数据集[17],并涂抹捕捉装置的纳迪尔盲点[48](见图4)。
这样就产生了2233 2233个培训样本。

blocks.en: We compare against three types of methods:
blocks.zh: 我们比较了三种方法:

blocks.en: Single-image illumination estimators. These methods capture spatially varying indoor illumination, but their output is a direct estimate rather than a parameterization, meaning there is no low-dimensional latent code that can be optimized against the observation. We consider DepthLight [ 41 ] , which uses a representation similar to our 2.5D area light but is obtained via outpainting, and 4D Lighting [ 50 ] , which inpaints chrome probes into the input image.
blocks.zh: 单像光谱估计器. 这些方法捕捉空间变化的室内照明,但其输出是直接估计,而不是参数化,这意味着没有低维潜伏代码可以对照观测进行优化. 我们认为深度光[41],它使用与我们的2.5D区光相似的表示,但通过外涂法获得,4D照明[50],将铬探测器印入输入图像.

blocks.en: Direct optimization (Smoothness). To isolate the prior’s contribution from the representation and fitting procedure, we directly optimize radiance and depth maps under the same setup ( 131,072 131{,}072 parameters vs. 513 513 for our prior at the same map resolution). To test the role of depth, we replace the mesh with a fixed-radius spherical proxy or remove it entirely via an environment map. Because unregularized optimization yields very noisy estimates, we apply NeRFactor’s smoothness constraint [ 65 ] on log-radiance and log-depth.

blocks.en:
Illumination priors, fitted through the same renderer. DPI [ 40 ] , using their original implementation, weights and fitting procedure while bypassing the material optimization.
VENI [ 54 ] , trained on our indoor split using the original implementation with matching latent size and resolution. VENI+D, no spatially-aware illumination prior exists to compare against, so we build one. We extend VENI with a depth channel, so that its latent decodes into a radiance–depth pair that can be lifted into a 2.5D area light. This isolates the contribution of our architecture from that of the representation: VENI+D shares our emitter and our fitting procedure, and differs only in the prior, making it a representative ablation.
blocks.zh:
光学前科,通过同样的渲染器安装. DPI [40],在绕过材料优化的同时,使用其原始执行,权重和适配程序.
VENI [54], 利用原始执行与潜在大小和分辨率匹配来训练我们室内分裂. VENI+D,之前没有空间感知的照明可以比较,所以我们建一个. 我们用一个深度通道来扩展 VENI, 这样它潜伏的解码成一个光线 – 深度对, 可以提升成2.5D 区域光线 。 这使我们的架构的贡献与代表的贡献相隔绝:VENI+D分享我们的发射器和我们的适配程序,只在前作中有所区别,使它成为代表性的废品.

blocks.en: 4.1 Illumination prior evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.1 先前的评估

blocks.en:
We first evaluate the prior directly, without a renderer.
The evaluation set consists of 25 25 real indoor HDR panoramas from a different source [ 43 ] , with pseudo-ground-truth depth from the same pipeline as the training data [ 57 ] .
Following the VENI [ 54 ] protocol, we report PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS in LDR tone-mapped space, as well as PSNR in linear HDR space.
We also include the Absolute Relative Error for measuring the depth performance.
Tab. 1 shows that our model outperforms VENI in both the autoencoder setting and decoder-only latent optimization.
Smoothness scores well here by construction: with one parameter per target value, its metrics report the level of smoothing imposed rather than representation quality, and are readable only alongside Sec. 4.2 .
Similarly, DPI [ 40 ] reconstructs through no bottleneck at all, as the target panorama is its measurement and guides the sampler at every step.

这套评价包括来自不同来源的25个真正的室内人类发展报告全景[43],其伪地面真相深度与培训数据相同[57]。
在VENI [54] 协议之后,我们报告在LDR调幅空间的PSNR,SSIM,和LPIPS,以及线性HDR空间的PSNR.
我们还包括测量深度性能的绝对相对错误。
Tab. 1 显示我们的模型在自动编码器设置和解码器唯一潜在优化中都优于VENI.
这里的平滑度通过构造得分很好:用每个目标值一个参数,其度量衡报告所施加的平滑度,而不是表示质量,并且只能与第4.2项同时读。
同样,DPI[40]通过没有任何瓶颈来重建,因为目标全景是它的测量,并指导采样者每一步.

Dataset. We build a dedicated dataset based on the 25 25 indoor panoramas [ 43 ] with estimated depth.
Unlike in the previous evaluation, we use a higher resolution of 512 × 1024 512\times 1024 and construct 2.5D area emitters as in Sec. 3.1 .
With the rendering camera placed at the emitter origin, we randomly position three objects at non-overlapping image coordinates, with their depths stratified across the range defined by the emitter extent.
The bunny and armadillo form the target observation used during optimization (Sec. 3.4 ), and the evaluation is performed on a view containing a sphere.
Every scene is rendered in three materials spanning the reflective spectrum: gray-diffuse, silver-matte, and silver-mirror, amounting to 75 75 cases ( 25 25 scenes × \times 3 3 materials).

每个场景都是用三个跨反射光谱的材料制作的:灰底膜、银质膜和银质镜,共计75 75件(25 25个场景x\time 3 3 个材料)。

blocks.en: Metrics. The optimized illumination representation is used as the emitter for rendering the evaluation probe on which we compute PSNR in tone-mapped space, RMSE in linear space and mean per-pixel RGB angular error in degrees [ 32 ] . RMSE measures intensity errors by heavily penalizing brightness discrepancies in light sources, while angular error isolates color accuracy by weighting all pixels equally regardless of scale.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 优化的射线表示法被用作制作评价探测器的发射器,我们在调幅空间中计算PSNR,在线性空间中计算RMSE,在度数中平均每像素RGB角误差[32]. RMSE通过重罚光源中的亮度差异来测量强度误差,而角错则通过对所有像素的加权均匀而不管大小来隔离颜色精度.

blocks.en:
Quantitative results in Tab. 2 demonstrate that near-field modeling yields substantial gains, as evidenced by the performance of both the smoothness baseline and VENI across different emitter representations.
Our prior leads on almost every case and metric, extending the advantage it showed
over VENI+D in the direct evaluation (Tab. 1 ) to the
inverse-rendering setting, albeit by a narrower margin.
The only metric on which our model does not lead is the angular error, for the diffuse and mirror probes. As this metric is scale-free, it can be won by an environment whose radiance is the right color but the wrong strength, which shows in the RMSE and PSNR metrics. The qualitative results in Fig. 5 further confirm the advantage of the data-driven priors over simple smoothness constraints. In the diffuse case, the directly optimized radiance is reduced to just a few bright blobs, while our prior produces more realistic details. The depth channel also highlights that the smoothness prior degenerates into a low-frequency field carrying no room structure, whereas our decoded depth resembles the reference layout.

A fair comparison against DepthLight [ 41 ] and 4DLighting [ 50 ] is not possible in this setting: both require a representative background, which we mask out during optimization, and the optimization-based arms would in any case hold an unfair advantage, isolating illumination with ground-truth object geometry and materials.
For completeness we report their results on this dataset in the supplementary material.

为了完整起见,我们在补充材料中就本数据集报告结果。

blocks.en: 4.3 Application on real images
blocks.zh: 4.3 对真实图像的应用

blocks.en:
The synthetic evaluation isolates illumination by assuming known geometry, materials and poses.
Single-view applications afford none of these.
Geometry can be recovered through generative reconstruction [ 1 , 9 , 61 ] or partially from monocular depth [ 56 , 8 ] , but materials must be estimated jointly with lighting, reintroducing the ambiguity that priors are meant to resolve.
We therefore evaluate our prior in a simplified analysis-by-synthesis setting on real images.
blocks.zh:
合成评价通过假设已知的几何,材料和姿势来隔离照明.
单景申请都买不起。
几何学可以通过基因重建[1,9,61]或部分从单元深度[56,8]恢复,但材料必须与照明一起估算,重新引申出前作意在解决的模糊性.
因此,我们先对真实图像进行简化综合分析。

blocks.en: From a single image we obtain camera intrinsics and a depth-based scene mesh [ 57 ] , and segment the objects of interest. Each object is assigned a single spatially-uniform material under an albedo–roughness–metallic parameterization. We then minimize the photometric loss over the material parameters, the exposure scale s s , and the latent code z z of our prior, which decodes into the 2.5D area light illuminating the reconstructed geometry.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
A 2.5D area light carries one radiance and one distance per direction, so depth discontinuities are bridged by triangles that weld foreground to background. Moreover, emitters standing among the objects rather than in the enclosure cannot be properly expressed.
The equirectangular parametrization adds to this by allocating many small triangles near the poles and few near the equator, where most details lie.
A further limitation lies in the fitting, where we rely on a repulsion term to keep the emitter from intersecting the scene content.
This works well in most cases, but it requires a set of scene points against which the clearance is measured, and it addresses a symptom rather than a cause: a perfectly recovered environment would enclose the scene without intersecting it, so no such term would be needed.
blocks.zh:
2.5D区光带一个光度和每个方向一个距离,因此深度不连续由三角形连接,将前缘焊接到背景. 此外,在物体之间而不是在附文中,发射体无法正确表示。
通过在极点附近划出许多小三角形,在赤道附近划出很少的三角形,使得平方形的半圆形变形增加了这一点,大部分细节都位于赤道附近.
另一个限制在于是否合适,我们依靠一个反感词来防止排放者与现场内容交叉。
这在多数情况下是行之有效的,但它需要一组场景点来测量清除情况,它涉及一个症状而不是一个原因:一个完全恢复的环境会包围现场而不交叉,因此不需要这样的术语。

blocks.en:
We introduced a learned illumination prior that represents indoor lighting as a 2.5D
area light rather than a far-field environment map. A single latent code decodes into
paired HDR radiance and radial depth, lifted into an emissive mesh directly usable with a
differentiable renderer. The finite extent of the emitter makes the
resulting light field vary with position, while the learned decoder keeps latent
optimization on the manifold of plausible rooms instead of the noisy solutions that
unconstrained pixel-level fitting produces. We show that this recovers illumination more faithfully than environment-map priors fitted through the same renderer across diverse indoor scenes and
materials.

blocks.en: Figure 8 extends Fig. 1 with panoramas captured at three locations: the center of each object and the midpoint between them. An environment map relights only the object at its capture location correctly, whereas the 2.5D area light reproduces both objects from every capture point.

blocks.en:
A 2.5D area light is only an approximation of the true illumination, as it captures a single depth per direction from the capture point. Surfaces hidden from that viewpoint are therefore absent, and depth discontinuities are bridged by triangles that are not a valid emitting surface.
To quantify how good the approximation is, we place three probe spheres in a path-traced living room, compute their appearance with the full light transport simulation, and compare it with relightings by 2.5D area lights and environment maps, as illustrated in Fig. 7 . The emitters are built from the true radiance and depth captured at three viewpoints in the scene, and Table 3 aggregates their results.
The 2.5D area light achieves 2 × 2\times to 5 × 5\times lower RMSE than the environment map for every material.
Still, the error is much higher than that between re-renderings of the scene with different seeds (noise floor), which is the gap a 2.5D area light cannot represent. This bounds what any method built on this representation, ours included, can recover.

为了量化近似值有多好,我们把三个探测器球放置在一个路径跟踪的客厅里,用完整的光传输模拟计算它们的外观,用2.5D区域灯光和环境地图来与重光进行对比,如Fig所示. 7 (英语). 发射器是用真实的光线和深度在现场三个角度上捕获的,表3汇总了它们的结果.

尽管如此,这个误差远高于不同种子(噪声地板)的场景重现之间,这是2.5D区光线不能代表的缺口. 这限制了任何基于这种代表性的方法,包括我们的方法,都能恢复。

blocks.en:
Panoramas captured with a tripod-mounted rig contain a nadir blind spot at the downward pole.
To inpaint this region, we tone-map the HDR panorama to LDR using the extended Reinhard operator [ 45 ] , then obtain a 512 × 512 512\times 512 top-down perspective view of the nadir area using gnomonic projection with an 80 ∘ 80^{\circ} field of view.
We inpaint the resulting hole with LaMa [ 48 ] and back-project the completed region into the panorama through the inverse gnomonic mapping.
Finally, the Reinhard mapping is inverted to restore HDR values in the completed region, leaving the rest of the panorama unchanged.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: While the domain-specific model DA360 [ 25 ] estimates 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} depth, it produces inconsistent predictions in transparent regions such as windows, with depth values exploding to high values (Fig. 9 ). Instead, we adopt MoGe-2 [ 57 ] , a depth estimator designed for perspective imagery. Following the authors’ pipeline, we extract 12 overlapping tangent-plane perspective views from the tone-mapped panorama, infer depth on each view, project the predictions back to the equirectangular domain, and fuse them via global consistency optimization. Additionally, we enforce spherical pole constraints during optimization to preserve topological continuity near the poles.
blocks.zh: 虽然特定域模型DA360 [25] 估计360 ∘ 360 ^{\circ}深度,但它在窗口等透明区域产生不一致的预测,深度值爆炸到高值(图9). 相反,我们采用了MoGe-2[57],这是为视角图像设计的深度估计器。 在作者的管道之后,我们从音调图的全景中提取了12个重叠的正切-平面视角观点,推断每个视角的深度,将预测推回等距域,并通过全球一致性优化来加以整合。 此外,我们在优化过程中执行球形杆的制约,以保持杆附近地形的连续性.

blocks.en:
We render the ground truth with 2.5D area lights instead of fully modeled 3D rooms for three reasons.
First, the ground truth is real illumination: no collection of 3D indoor scenes with measured emitters exists at comparable diversity, and evaluating a prior trained on real panoramas on synthetic scenes would confound its quality with the domain gap.
Second, the problem is well-posed: an exact solution exists, so the scores measure the distance to it, and the recovered radiance and depth can be compared to the reference directly (Fig. 5 ). Against a 3D room every 2.5D emitter is bounded by the ceiling of Tab. 3 , under which the differences between priors would be harder to read.
Third, the setup extends the protocol of prior work [ 16 , 54 , 40 ] , which evaluates on objects lit by a panorama, by giving the panorama a finite distance.

我们用2.5D区域灯光 而不是完全模拟的3D房间来渲染地面真相,原因有三。

其次,问题存在:存在精确的解决方案,因此得分量到它的距离,恢复的光度和深度可以直接与参考物(图5)进行比较. 每2.5D的发射器对着一个3D室以Tab的天花板为界. 3,根据该词,前身之间的区别将更难读取.

blocks.en: The encoder is a 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutional stem of width 64 64 followed by four downsampling stages with channel multipliers ( 1 , 2 , 4 , 4 ) (1,2,4,4) , one residual block per stage, GroupNorm with 8 8 groups and SiLU activations. blocks.en:
Retraining DPI [ 40 ] is reported to take one week on four A100 GPUs, so we run its released model with its own sampler and fitting procedure, bypassing only the material optimization. Its model was trained on the Laval Indoor HDR dataset [ 17 ] without nadir inpainting, so every predicted panorama carries a black cap at the bottom. This highlights the importance of our preprocessing, but also entangles DPI’s performance with a limitation of its training data.
To disentangle the two, we mask the probe pixels that DPI cannot represent (Fig. 10 ) and recompute the metrics on the rest, applying the same mask to every method and to the ground truth (Tab. 4 ). We report this only for the mirror probe, where each pixel reflects a single direction and the affected region is well defined; on the diffuse and matte probes the cap contributes to nearly every pixel. Masking improves DPI’s scores and slightly lowers the others’. It substantially reduces DPI’s deficit relative to VENI, but explains only a small part of its deficit relative to the 2.5D area light methods.

blocks.en: C.4 Computational cost

blocks.en: Tab. 7 summarizes the cost of the learned priors. During inverse rendering the decoder is not the bottleneck, as each iteration is dominated by path tracing. The gradients of a 2.5D area light, which flow through the emitter’s geometry as well as its texture, are more expensive to compute than those of an environment map, which explains why fitting the observation through our prior takes significantly longer than through VENI.
blocks.zh: 附表7总结了所学前科的费用。 在反向渲染解码器时不是瓶颈,因为每次迭代都以路径追踪为主. 2.5D区域光线的梯度通过发射者的几何及其纹理流动,计算成本比环境图的梯度高,这解释了为什么通过我们以前的观测比通过VENI需要相当长的时间。
